description: List the website monitors (tasks) in the monity.ai account: name, monitored URL, type, active state, labels, and last/next check times. Use this first to find a monitor's uuid for the other tools.

compareTypes.description: Only monitors of these compare types

createdOn.description: Only monitors created on this date (yyyy-mm-dd, UTC)

frequencies.description: Only monitors checking at one of these frequencies (minutes, as strings)

labelIds.description: Only monitors carrying one of these labels (ids from list_labels)

lastAlertFrom.description: Only monitors whose last change is on or after this ISO date

lastAlertTo.description: Only monitors whose last change is on or before this ISO date

search.description: Search monitor name or URL, case insensitive

sort.description: Task list sort order; default newest created

thresholds.description: Only monitors with one of these change thresholds

workspaceId.description: Only monitors in this workspace (from list_workspaces)

name: list_monitors
title: List monitors
